#!/bin/ash
# Downloads the latest release ZIP (pterodactyl-manga-shelf.zip) into the server folder and unpacks it.
# On a reinstall only the files the ZIP ships are replaced; data/, .env, ssl/ and uploads/ stay.
set -e
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1 || apk add --no-cache curl
command -v unzip >/dev/null 2>&1 || apk add --no-cache unzip

URL="https://github.com/LixNix-Swap-Org/manga-shelf/releases/latest/download/pterodactyl-manga-shelf.zip"
echo "Manga Shelf: downloading $URL"
if ! curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o /tmp/pterodactyl-manga-shelf.zip "$URL"; then
    echo "Manga Shelf: download failed. Upload pterodactyl-manga-shelf.zip from the releases to the server files, unpack it and start the server."

fi
unzip -o -q /tmp/pterodactyl-manga-shelf.zip -d /mnt/server
rm -f /tmp/pterodactyl-manga-shelf.zip
test -f /mnt/server/index.js
echo "Manga Shelf: installed. Start the server; the setup code appears in the console."

variables.name: Behind a reverse proxy
variables.description: Tick this when Nginx, Caddy or another reverse proxy on the host sits in front of this server. The server then believes the proxy's X-Forwarded-For (it adds the gateway of the Docker network, usually 172.18.0.1, to TRUST_PROXY), so login limits and locks count the real client address. Bind the allocation to 127.0.0.1 so the port is reachable only through the proxy. Leave it off without a proxy. It has no effect when TRUST_PROXY below is set to something other than loopback.

variables.name: Trust Proxy
variables.description: Which reverse proxies may set the client address via X-Forwarded-For. Default: loopback (only a proxy on the same host). Behind another proxy enter its address; proxy on the host in front of Pterodactyl: only the gateway of pterodactyl_nw (loopback, 172.18.0.1), never the whole subnet (other servers on the node could otherwise fake any address), otherwise all clients share one login limit. The allocation then has to be reachable only through the proxy (e.g. bound to 127.0.0.1), otherwise anyone can fake a foreign address directly and lock its login; that applies all the more to a hop count (1), which trusts every peer. IPv6 clients via docker-proxy appear as the gateway address (e.g. 172.17.0.1); so do not open up private networks wholesale. false = no proxy. Invalid values prevent the start.

variables.name: TMDB API Key
variables.description: Optional key for films and TV shows in the anime tab (free for non-commercial use at themoviedb.org/settings/api: the 32-character API key or the read access token). Without a key there are no TMDB hits unless a user stores a personal key in the account dialog. Empty = not set.

variables.name: Time Zone
variables.description: What "today" is for the radar, calendar and anime dates, as an IANA name such as Europe/Berlin or America/New_York. An unknown name is ignored with a warning and Europe/Berlin applies.

variables.name: Backup Hour
variables.description: Hour of the day (0 to 23, in the time zone BACKUP_TIMEZONE, default Europe/Berlin) at which the daily automatic backup runs.

variables.name: Daily Backups Kept
variables.description: How many daily automatic backups are kept (1 to 1000). Backups use the disk space of the server.

variables.name: Log Level
variables.description: How much the console shows: debug (everything, for troubleshooting), info, warn, error or silent.

variables.name: Install Updates From The App
variables.description: On: admins can install updates under System, Updates. Off: the list of releases and the manual steps stay, but the app refuses to download and install; update by uploading the ZIP instead.

variables.name: Setup Code
variables.description: Optional fixed setup code for the first admin account (at least 12 characters, spaces and hyphens do not count; shorter values are ignored). Empty = a random code is printed in the console at every start until an admin exists.
